wrist_camera._source: NOT MEASURED - a placeholder. d1-2's wrist fisheye has no nameplate and has not been calibrated; these numbers only let the kinematic mirror dry-run the look-before-stroke policy. A live (firmware) run ignores a block marked measured:false and stops with look_unavailable: calibrate the lens and put its intrinsics here before a live look.

hand._source: d1-2's gripper driven-open gap: d1-firmwared 0.3.0 reports open_rad 1.35 on d1-2 (2026-09-22) = 60.5 mm through the hand description's 44.8 mm/rad map. Used by --executor kinematic, which has no hand to read; on hardware the executor reads open_rad from the daemon and that wins.
